channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: At Lincoln Park’s North Pond, Chef César Murillo Lets The Seasons Set The Menu
item.description: Murillo finds inspiration by preserving the yield from the restaurant’s rooftop garden and beehives and nurturing a hyperlocal approach in the kitchen, even in winter.

item.title: South Loop’s Burger Point To Close As Printers Row Gets 2 New Bars
item.description: The Black-owned restaurant will close Tuesday after months of declining sales, owner Michael Strotter said. In Printers Row, Reserv is open and Pressbox is slated for the former Bar Louie.

item.title: Chicago Schools Will Get About $200 Million More From City Council TIF Surplus
item.description: The additional dollars will not result in a windfall for classrooms as the school system continues to adjust spending, eliminate vacant positions, and account for increased interest payments on debt.

item.title: Chicago’s Top Chefs Unite For Todos Ponen, A Fundraiser For 125 Immigrant Families
item.description: Restaurateurs Diana Dávila and Marcos Carbajal will bring together more than 40 chefs for the Jan. 19 event at the Ramova Theatre. Proceeds will supply families impacted by ICE with groceries from local supermercados.

item.title: Chicago 2025 In 100 Photos: Moments To Remember From The Neighborhoods
item.description: From Roseland to Rogers Park and Austin to the Loop, Block Club’s reporters share memorable moments from 2025.

item.title: Going To ‘Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve’ Downtown? Here’s What You Need To Know
item.description: Chicago's first live countdown of the famed New Year's Eve celebration kicks off 7 p.m. Wednesday. Gates open at 5 p.m. for the free event.

item.title: Block Club’s 10 Most Popular Stories Of 2025
item.description: From federal agents descending on a South Shore apartment to the sweetest melons in town, here's what resonated with Block Club readers in 2025.

item.title: Block Club’s 5 Most Popular Food Stories Of 2025
item.description: From a profile of the South Side's famed Watermelon Man to another roundup of classic Chicago dive bars, these were our most-read food stories of the year.

item.title: River North Mass Shooting Kills 1, Wounds 3 Others, Police Say
item.description: Four men were entering a Lamborghini when a group of men walked up to them and opened fire, according to police and media reports.

item.title: 3 Wounded In Shooting Near St. Sabina Church After Adult Basketball Game
item.description: Three men in their 30s were taken to local hospitals, where their conditions stabilized, police said. "You expect that people that age have a little more sense and a little more wisdom than this kind of craziness,” said the Rev. Michael Pfleger.
